name: learning-strategy
description: Tutors you through learning any topic with ten study strategies (ELI5, 80/20, mind map, schematic, first principles, Socratic questioning, Feynman technique, visual study guide, quiz me, sticky notes), one at a time or as a ten-step sequence that ends in spaced review. Asks one question at a time and saves notes only in learning/<topic>/ after you say yes.
